name: Solyanka
description: A thick, tangy soup with a kick of heat. Diced ingredients are simmered together in clear river water, while pickled fish and vegetables give the broth its distinctive character. Its rich orange-red hue hints at a bold medley of sour, spicy, and savory flavors, each unfolding with every spoonful.

suspicious.description: A thick, tangy soup with a kick of heat. The tang of the pickled vegetables and the saltiness of the cured fish are already at odds when the heat comes barging in, turning the whole thing into a three-way brawl. Not one flavor is willing to back down, and the result is a chaotic, bitter mess. Even the least picky Volkodlak would probably think twice before finishing a bowl...

delicious.description: A thick, tangy soup with a kick of heat. Lift the lid, and the rich orange-red broth bubbles away invitingly in the pot. Take a sip, and the tang and heat burst to life on the tongue, followed by the deep, savory richness slowly coaxed out over a wood fire... As the warmth settles into your stomach, it feels as though your whole body has been wrapped in a thick, cozy blanket.
